name: Interlock
description: A tab on one side and a socket on the other, so the row cannot come apart.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 62% 0, 62% 38%, 84% 50%, 62% 62%, 62% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 62% 0, 62% 38%, 84% 50%, 62% 62%, 62% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(62% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 62% 100%, 62% 62%, 84% 50%, 62% 38%); clip-path: polygon(62% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 62% 100%, 62% 62%, 84% 50%, 62% 38%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
